title: Mandatory subscription
body:
the app has you do the regular onboarding and sign in stuff, THEN before you even get to look at the app you HAVE to subscripe. even though you feature a free trial this is scummy. let me check it out first before youre asking people to commit such high ammounts of money. 
youre getting an extra star because you do actually have a program for people with financial problems, but still you gotta apply for that. 

tldr: dont make me make an account then not let me even check out the app before you ask for money. then you shouldsay that BEFORE i make an account
author: Tic12348

title: Useless
body: Completely useless app for me. I didn’t get notified about the end of trial, and the sibscription was not in apple store although I got the sub from app (which i couldn’t remember). They drew in total 60 dollars from my account before I noticed, and then I tried to unsub. Through their website there was no card information stored on my account, and I had to rediwbload and relogin to the app that was hardly used. No notifications. Nothing. They seem to profit off of people with adhd and their forgetfulness. They never replied to my email.
author: nanodahl

title: The AI chat is wonderful
body: I never thought I would say that an app could be helpful, but this one really is! When I am home alone and need prompting or motivation to get started on a task it gives good, useful tips and also cheers me on; it also gives me the “allowance” that I need to take a rest when I have accomplished many chores. It keeps track of the tasks I have accomplished and that is a good reminder when I feel that I should have done more. Brilliant!
author: Camilla the Norse
